rationale: The Python jobs already cache dependencies via setup-uv with enable-cache and a uv.lock key, so no change is needed there (an equivalent cache already exists). The test-typescript-sdk job runs `bun install` in sdks/typescript with no dependency cache, even though the change filter already limits it to TypeScript-relevant runs. Following the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE dependency-download caching pattern (lockfile-keyed actions/cache placed before the install step), add a cache step for sdks/typescript/node_modules keyed by bun.lock before `bun install`. This preserves every install and test step, keeps all required checks and the change filter intact, adds no privileges, secrets, publishing/deployment, or new external network access beyond the standard actions/cache action, and mirrors the measured node-module caching experiment.
